UI_Cybertruck_WhereSettings: These are the world settings, set when you create a world (New Game > Sandbox > Advanced > Cybertruck). On a server, the admin sets them for everyone.
UI_Cybertruck_Override: Use these settings in single player
UI_Cybertruck_Override_tip: On: the dials below apply to your solo games right away, instead of the world's settings. Off, or on any server: the world's settings apply. Spawn changes only affect areas you haven't explored yet.
UI_Cybertruck_FireKey_tip: Hold it, or the left mouse button, from the gun seat to fire at the zombie outlined in red.
UI_Cybertruck_GunVolume_tip: How loud the roof gun is for you, in percent. Only changes what you hear: zombies still hear every shot.
